mapper.select: SELECT max(product.change_team_number) as changeTeamNumber, product.change_team_type FROM bm_product_instruction_team AS team JOIN bm_product_change_team AS product ON team.id = product.product_instruction_team_id where team.is_deleted = 0 and product.is_deleted = 0 and team.product_plan_id = #{planId} and team.procedure_model_id = #{procedureModelId} GROUP BY product.change_team_type

SELECT team.id as id, team.instruction_id as instructionId, team.product_plan_id as productPlanId, team.procedure_step_model_id as procedureStepModelId, team.procedure_step_model_name as procedureStepModelName, team.procedure_step_time as procedureStepTime, team.procedure_step_time_unit as procedureStepTimeUnit, product.team_ids as teamIds, product.change_team_number as productChangeNumber, product.change_team_type as productChangeType, team.sort as sort, product.id as changeTeamId FROM bm_product_instruction_team AS team JOIN bm_product_change_team AS product ON team.id = product.product_instruction_team_id WHERE team.is_deleted = 0 AND product.is_deleted = 0 AND team.product_plan_id =#{planId} AND product.change_team_type =#{nodeFunction} and product.change_team_number =#{changeNumber} ORDER BY product.change_team_type asc,product.change_team_number desc
